description: KNa₄Cl₅ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. K is bonded to six Cl atoms to form KCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaCl₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent KCl₆ octahedra, and edges with ten NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-5°. There are two shorter (3.00 Å) and four longer (3.03 Å) K-Cl bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one KCl₆ octahedra, corners with five NaCl₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent KCl₆ octahedra, and edges with ten NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-9°. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.77-2.88 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent KCl₆ octahedra, corners with four NaCl₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent KCl₆ octahedra, and edges with nine NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-9°. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.77-2.96 Å. There are three inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded to one K and five Na atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClKNa₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-3°. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded to two equivalent K and four Na atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClK₂Na₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-7°. In the third Cl site, Cl is bonded to six Na atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClNa₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-7°.
